<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_BecomingAParent" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ParentProcess" name="Becoming A Parent" processRef="Process_BecomingAParent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompanies" name="Notify companies" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompanies" targetRef="Participant_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" name="Company information" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Planning maternity leave begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_FetchModels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchModels" name="Fetch information about potential models">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_FetchModels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FetchModels_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectModel" name="Let parent select a model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FetchModels_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_CollectInformation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_CollectInformation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_NotifySplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify both recipients">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_NotifySplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifySplit_SocialSecurity</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifySplit_Companies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifySplit_SocialSecurity</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifySocialSecurity_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompanies" name="Notify company in time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifySplit_Companies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyCompanies_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifyJoin" name="Notifications complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifySocialSecurity_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyCompanies_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyJoin_GatherCompanyInformation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from companies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyJoin_GatherCompanyInformation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GatherInformation_PeriodEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PeriodEnd" name="Maternity leave period ends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GatherInformation_PeriodEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PeriodEnd_DecideExtension</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_PeriodEnd"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="Let parent decide about extension">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PeriodEnd_DecideExtension</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecideExtension_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extension decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecideExtension_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExtensionChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoExtension</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExtensionChosen" name="Extension chosen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExtensionChosen</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoExtension" name="No extension chosen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoExtension</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_FetchModels" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_FetchModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FetchModels_Select" sourceRef="Task_FetchModels" targetRef="Task_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_CollectInformation" sourceRef="Task_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_NotifySplit" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySplit_SocialSecurity" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySplit_Companies" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySocialSecurity_Join" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyCompanies_Join" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompanies" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyJoin_GatherCompanyInformation" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherInformation_PeriodEnd" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Event_PeriodEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PeriodEnd_DecideExtension" sourceRef="Event_PeriodEnd" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecideExtension_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionChosen" name="Extension chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_ExtensionChosen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoExtension" name="No extension chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoExtension"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
